name: Adaptive sampling and reconstruction
definition: An end-to-end pipeline that uses neural networks to predict where high sample density is needed, convert importance values to adaptive sample positions, and reconstruct full-resolution images from sparse samples.
summary: Adaptive sampling and reconstruction is an end-to-end neural pipeline that predicts high-density sampling locations using an importance network to allocate computational resources only to visually important regions, achieving high fidelity with significantly fewer volume queries.
